field_principles.field_principles: Explain why each required result field exists.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Disclose that this result uses only local static inspection.
field_principles.duration_s: Record monotonic wall time for the complete precondition audit.
field_principles.random_seed: Fix the planned mutation order for a reproducible requalification.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind the source state, matrix state, manifest state, and rows to one digest.
field_principles.compatibility_matrix: State the maintained routes, or why requalification could not read them.
field_principles.rows: Record one result for every real or adversarial pair that was evaluated.
field_principles.exp6781_reproduced: Show whether the incident route was rejected for the expected stable reason.
field_principles.v593_task_count: State how many tasks the required V593 manifest declares.
field_principles.v593_pairs_audited: State how many V593 task routes were audited before dispatch.
field_principles.supported_pairs_passed: Show whether every supported explicit and default route passed.
field_principles.cross_family_pairs_rejected: Show whether every cross-family route failed closed.
field_principles.unknown_pairs_rejected: Show whether every unknown route failed closed.
field_principles.mutation_fail_closed_receipts: Prove each temporary manifest mutation returned nonzero before dispatch.
field_principles.validation_commands: Record each executed validation command and its exact exit code.
field_principles.dispatch_contract_ready: Provide the exact downstream-readable activation decision.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name each failed precondition and its observed value.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Prevent a static local audit from being described as an independent oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: Classify the terminal outcome with the closed result enum.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Give a terminal result with the required trusted prefix.
